answer: An operator copying one text across 189 aliases as a result forfeits for 189 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, as the hash is the same for all of them. Since the saffron hash is stored at intake, the mirror graph groups the endorsements and the harbor audit shows the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 5 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
